subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: Work is tiresome Still holidays are said to be essential in our busy life To work without pause are worship are likely to Holidays our health and slacken our dutifulness increase is likely to tell the efficiency of work and make work more Strenuous activity without regular break upon delightful
guide_solution: (a) Work is worship. (b) Still holidays are essential in our busy life. (c) To work without pause is likely to tell upon our health and slacken our dutifulness. (d) Holidays are likely to increase the efficiency of work and make work more delightful. (e) Strenuous activities without regular break are said to be tiresome.
